description: Source code for WebSocket handshake stream base class, including static methods for header validation, extension handling, and handshake result recording.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for handling WebSocket handshake stream, including static validation methods and handshake result recording.

methods.name: MultipleHeaderValuesMessage
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating a header must not appear more than once.

methods.name: AddVectorHeaderIfNonEmpty
methods.description: Adds a header with comma-joined values if the vector is not empty.

methods.name: ValidateSubProtocol
methods.description: Validates the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header against requested protocols.

methods.name: ValidateExtensions
methods.description: Validates WebSocket extensions in response headers and updates parameters.

methods.name: RecordHandshakeResult
methods.description: Records the result of the WebSocket handshake for metrics.
